description:
Outcome: Add visitors and retrieve queue, from BRIEF.md and owner first-name/day-end constraints.
Scope: Visitor model, bounded plain-text first-name/item validation, add/list API, unique IDs, FIFO, C1-approved storage and retention, no-store headers, authoritative day expiry, no payload logging or visitor backups. Excludes: claim/finish and accounts.
Acceptance: Nonblank bounded fields; stable unique IDs distinguish duplicate names; FIFO; approved restart/retention semantics; no expired record served. If SQLite is selected, close/delete daily database and sidecars at running midnight and purge expired stores before startup serves.
Behaviour: Explicit invalid-input, empty, persistence-error and rollover-race handling.
Verification: Validation, duplicate-name, restart, expiry/purge and race tests with isolated temporary stores matching the C1 ruling. Prerequisites: B2 verification/startup and C1 privacy ruling. Assumptions: storage blocked until conflict resolved; configured cafe timezone.
Setup label: Q1.
title: Visitor queue API
